title: How I Use ChatGPT to Prepare for Meetings Automatically
description:
Most people are still using ChatGPT like a chatbot.
But the real shift is using it as a remote AI assistant.

With ChatGPT connected to Codex, you can start a task from your phone while your computer does the work.

In this example, ChatGPT checks a calendar event, searches for relevant context, and prepares meeting notes before the conversation even begins.
Instead of manually opening your calendar, emails, notes, and documents, the agent gathers the information for you in the background.

This is where AI starts becoming part of your workflow instead of just answering questions.
If you spend your day switching between meetings, emails, and projects, this kind of setup can help you arrive with the right context already prepared.
The biggest change isn't having a smarter chatbot.

It's having AI that can work across your devices and help you stay organized before you even open your laptop.
